translations.web: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.
translations.bsb: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah.
